name: Release Engineering, Packaging & Rollback Readiness
purpose: Cut safe, traceable software releases with SemVer versioning, reproducible signed packaging, checksum verification, bidirectional migration rehearsals, staged rollouts, and rehearsed rollback plans.
inputs: Release scope: SemVer version number, included change list, target environments
Artifact inventory: binaries, container images, migration bundles, destination registries
Migration surface: schema versions, downgrade support matrix, production-shaped snapshot
Rollback budget: maximum acceptable recovery time and on-call rotation for the window
outputs: Published release: version tag, changelog, signed artifacts with checksums, SBOM, provenance
Migration report with upgrade/downgrade timings and data-integrity confirmation
Rollout and rollback plan with stage gates, halt thresholds, and measured recovery time
stop_conditions: Release published with verified signatures, rehearsed migrations, and staged rollout complete
Rollback rehearsed within the recovery budget with previous-version artifacts pre-staged
Release formally aborted with artifacts yanked and a recorded abort reason
